ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { userId: attributes.uriParams.userId, goalType: payload.goalType, targetUnit: payload.targetUnit default null, isPrimary: payload.isPrimary default false, targetValue: payload.targetValue default null, goalDirection: payload.goalDirection default null }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.user.userId } --- buildLog("INFO","Create goal started",message,vars.correlationId, vars.flowName)]

validation:is-false.doc:name: weight_management + no direction
validation:is-false.message: goal direction is required for weight management goals

db:select.doc:name: Select units_system
db:select.db:sql: SELECT units_system FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = :userId

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- if ( vars.user.targetUnit != null ) vars.user.targetUnit else if ( vars.user.goalType == "weight_management" ) if ( vars.userPreferences.units_system == "imperial" ) "lbs" else "kg" else if ( vars.user.goalType == "sleep_improvement" ) "hrs" else null

db:select.doc:name: Select is_primary
db:select.db:sql: SELECT is_primary,goal_id FROM user_goals WHERE user_id = :userId AND is_primary = True;

logger.doc:name: Update Primary Goal
logger.message:
#[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.user.userId, goalId: vars.existingPrimaryGoalId
} --- buildLog("INFO","Updating Primary Goal",message,vars.correlationId, vars.flowName)]

db:update.doc:name: Set Existing Goal to False
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE user_goals SET is_primary = false WHERE goal_id = :goalId

logger.doc:name: Update Primary Goal
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.user.userId } --- buildLog("INFO","No Updates to Primary Goal",message,vars.correlationId, vars.flowName)]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Into user_goals
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO user_goals (user_id, goal_type, goal_direction, target_value, target_unit, is_primary, is_active, set_at) VALUES (:userId, :goalType::goal_type_enum, :goalDirection::goal_direction_enum, :targetValue, :targetUnit, :isPrimary, true, now())
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ userId: vars.user.userId, goalType: vars.user.goalType, goalDirection: vars.user.goalDirection, targetValue: vars.user.targetValue, targetUnit: vars.user.targetUnit, isPrimary: vars.user.isPrimary }]

db:select.doc:name: Select Goal
db:select.db:sql: SELECT goal_id, user_id, goal_type, goal_direction, target_value, target_unit, is_primary, is_active, set_at, achieved_at FROM user_goals WHERE goal_id = :goalId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { goalId: payload[0].goal_id, userId: payload[0].user_id, goalType: payload[0].goal_type, goalDirection: payload[0].goal_direction, targetValue: payload[0].target_value, targetUnit: payload[0].target_unit, isPrimary: payload[0].is_primary, isActive: payload[0].is_active, setAt: payload[0].set_at, achievedAt: payload[0].achieved_at }

logger.doc:name: Goal created successfully
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.user.userId, goalId: vars.goal_id } --- buildLog("INFO","Goal created successfully",message,vars.correlationId, vars.flowName)]
